ownerSql: SELECT user_id FROM projects WHERE id = ?
lockOwnerSql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE
lockProjectSql: SELECT user_id FROM projects WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE
planSql: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.enabled = 1 AND r.id IN ('pro', 'admin') WHERE ur.user_id = ? AND JSON_CONTAINS(ur.roles, JSON_QUOTE(r.id)) AND (r.id = 'admin' OR ur.pro_expires_at IS NULL OR ur.pro_expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP())) AS is_pro
usageSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(CAST(r.doc AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4))), 0) AS used_bytes FROM project_rows r JOIN projects p ON p.id = r.project_id WHERE p.user_id = ?
rowSql: SELECT pk, OCTET_LENGTH(CAST(doc AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4)) AS row_bytes FROM project_rows WHERE project_id = ? AND table_id = ? AND pk = ? FOR UPDATE
sizeSql: SELECT OCTET_LENGTH(CAST(CAST(? AS JSON) AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4)) AS row_bytes
